title: Eromanga-sensei OVA
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 319410 and TMDB show 70878. Anime-Lists leaves episodeoffset empty on this season 0 node, which places no regular episode; offset 0 places them. AniDB episode 1-2 ("山田エルフのラブソング" (Elf Yamada`s Love Song) to "和泉紗霧のファーストキス" (Sagiri Izumi`s First Kiss)) are TVDB S0E1 "Elf Yamada's Love Song" to TVDB S0E2 "Sagiri Izumi's First Kiss"; AniDB S1 "藤田茜のエロマンガ先生布教の旅 in Hawaii" (Fujita Akane`s Trip to Hawaii) has no TVDB episode (its default TVDB S0E1 is "Elf Yamada's Love Song", another item) and no TMDB episode (its default TMDB S0E1 is "Elf Yamada’s Love Song", another item).
